title: AuthorityLevels
description: SAIA-Class S authority hierarchy defining sovereign, delegated, and observer authority levels within Beast System 3.0.

levels.description: Ordered list of authority levels from highest to lowest.

code.description: Authority code (e.g., SOVEREIGN, DOCTRINAL, DELEGATE, OBSERVER).

rank.description: Numeric rank for ordering (higher = more authority).

name.description: Human-readable name of the authority level.

description.description: Explanation of the authority level's scope and powers.

permissions.description: Optional list of permissions granted at this authority level.
